value: antheridiogen-type signalling inferred from field gametophyte colonies: of 322 gametophytes in 3 colonies, males were 63%, females 20% and asexual 17% (G = 119.34, df = 2, P < 0.001); males clustered with and near females in Colony 2 (P = 0.002) and Colony 3 (P < 0.001) but not in Colony 1 (chi2 = 12.40, df = 11, P = 0.334); asexual gametophytes in Colony 3 had a significant spatial association with females in the negative direction, that is, dispersed away from them (Fig. 5F); sex distribution did not differ among colonies (G = 4.21, df = 4, P = 0.377); females were random in every colony
method: naturally occurring gametophyte colonies collected whole with their substrate, sex of each gametophyte scored under the microscope and mapped, quadrat chi-square tests and random-labelling Ripley K(r) with 39 simulations against the 95% envelope
conditions: one site, a tip-up mound at La Selva Biological Station, Costa Rica, three colonies collected January 2019; no antheridiogen bioassay was run, the effect is inferred from the spatial pattern; Colony 1 has 98 gametophytes in Table 1 and n = 95 in the Discussion, an unresolved conflict in the paper (Table 1 total of 322 fits 98); male share was 61% (60 of 98), 68% (51 of 75) and 62% (92 of 149) in Colonies 1, 2 and 3 (Table 1), the abstract giving 62-68%; no hermaphrodites

value: fresh seeds did not germinate in the dark at any temperature regime; in light 2015 seeds reached above 80% at 25 C, about 50% at 20 C and 0% at 10 and 5 C (2014 seeds germinated poorly, under 50%, and under 5% at 15/5 C); dry after-ripening raised germination and widened the temperature range in light (p < 0.001, both species), but its effect in the dark was not significant in P. secundiflora (it was in P. sikkimensis); cold-stratified seeds in the dark responded to 15/5 against 10 C but not to 25/15 against 20 C; the Discussion adds that GA3 and dry cold-storage could still significantly increase germination (Supplementary Figure S1, both species)
method: germination of fresh, dry after-ripened, dry cold-stored and cold-wet-stratified seeds in light and in darkness across constant and alternating temperatures
conditions: laboratory; Hengduan Mountains seed collections 2013-2015; 12 h photoperiod at 22.2 umol m-2 s-1 cool white fluorescent light on in the warmer phase; three replicates of 20 seeds per test; dark dishes wrapped in foil; the dry after-ripening sentence covers both species and the dark result is split by species; the GA3 and cold-storage sentence is a Discussion statement shared by both species, no separate GA3 dose is read here
